Your terminal.

We’re opening it to professionals and startup teams. Run it in an authorized environment. Inspect the results. Tell us what deserves to be better.

04 / THE DETAILS

Before
you begin.

Ask us a question ↗
Is KryonSec a terminal tool?−

Yes. KryonSec is a terminal-based security testing product. This website introduces it; the terminal above is an illustrative demonstration, not the actual tool.

Who is the beta for?+

Security professionals and technical startup teams who can test in an owned lab or explicitly authorized environment and share candid feedback.

What does the beta cost?+

The professional beta is free. Access dates, supported testing scope and usage limits are agreed during onboarding. There is no automatic paid conversion.

How do I install the tool?+

Request beta access and we’ll share the actual installation instructions and supported environments during onboarding. The commands in this page’s demo are illustrative.

How should I share findings?+

Use the feedback form for your experience and suggestions. Sensitive findings should be shared only through the secure channel agreed during onboarding.
